title: Murder on Mosquito Island
summary: A survival instructor is found stabbed on Mosquito Island. All of the suspects were accounted for at the camp.
method: After the victim was stabbed, he used moss to patch the wound. He then went back to the camp and announced to everyone that he was going to review the traps. He went to another beach, made it look like there was an intruder, then died in a forest after removing the moss. The moss was placed in his canteen.
motive: The killer felt guilty about causing the victim trauma in the past and didn't want him to suffer further by going to jail for the crime. He was very self loathing and wanted to repent for his former crimes.
killer: One of the students, who was bullied by the instructor as a child
tags: victim tries to cover up the crime
